tool_generate_purpose: Design a Color Scheme from starting colours, with contrast values, scales 50–950, CSS and a generator link.
tool_generate_example: Suggest colours for the briefing. Keep Harbor's orange.
tool_generate_state: Calculates roles, scales and warnings like the generator, without saving. Missing brand or neutral colours are rolled from approved reference palettes, with their source. Use all references, a project or named references. Without colours in the pool, it rolls freely.
tool_list_kits_purpose: List approved Brand Kits with name, slug, project, brand colour and primary.
tool_list_kits_example: Is there already a Brand Kit for Harbor?
tool_list_kits_state: Only approved kits are visible. Drafts and archived kits stay hidden. Approval takes effect on the next call. Optionally filter by project.
tool_get_kit_purpose: Read a complete approved Brand Kit, including roles, contrast, scales, warnings, sources, notes and CSS.
tool_get_kit_example: Build Harbor's booking page using the Brand Kit colours.
tool_get_kit_state: Look up by slug or project, using the saved snapshot. Notes are returned verbatim and CSS matches the copied export. Source references include slug and title. Archived sources are omitted; deleted sources are marked. Missing approved kits are reported without exposing drafts. recommend and search_screens link to a project's kit.
tool_recommend_purpose: Start a briefing with matching references, your notes, page structure and palette in one call.
tool_recommend_example: I am building a calm landing page for a boutique hotel. Where should I start?
tool_recommend_state: Ranks by words and meaning. Favourites and matches in your notes carry more weight. Take, avoid and focus notes are returned verbatim. Collection and project filters are strict. Fewer than three matches are reported rather than widening the filters. Inspo no longer supplies its own design rules.
tool_search_purpose: Search approved references by text and filters such as style, industry and light or dark mode.
tool_search_example: Show me dark references with large, calm typography.
tool_search_state: Searches titles, notes, tags and AI analyses. With embeddings it also searches by meaning, so a German briefing can find English tags. Optionally limit to a collection or project. Paper brightness, display class and accent hue filters are not applied yet.
tool_color_purpose: Find references whose palette is close to a hex colour.
tool_color_example: Our brand is pine green #1f4d3a. Which references use a similar colour well?
tool_color_state: Searches palettes read from imported pages and estimated by AI. Each match includes the closest colour and its origin, with confidence for estimates.
tool_macro_purpose: Show real examples of a named page structure, such as Bento Grid or Marquee Hero.
tool_macro_example: I want to build a Bento Grid. What does it look like on real pages?
tool_macro_state: Finds references where AI identified this structure, one per website, including marked areas.
tool_taxonomy_purpose: List the values accepted by other tools' filters.
tool_taxonomy_example: Which styles and page structures can I use as filters?
tool_taxonomy_state: The vocabulary is built in. Coverage counts approved references whose AI analysis identified each structure.
tool_reference_purpose: Read a complete reference with images, source and your take, avoid, focus and favourite notes.
tool_reference_example: What should I take from this reference, and what should I avoid?
tool_reference_state: Returns images, source, notes, AI analysis and design values. Each value includes its origin, whether read from the page or estimated by AI with confidence. Unmeasured values stay empty.
tool_design_purpose: Export a reference's design values as DESIGN.md, with fonts, palette, CSS variables and type scale.
tool_design_example: Which fonts, colours and spacing does this page use?
tool_design_state: Returns saved design values with their origins. Reading the source page live requires an explicit request and follows URL checks, time limits and size limits. Nothing is saved.
tool_flow_purpose: Show a website's pages in order, such as home, pricing and features.
tool_flow_example: How does this website lead from the home page to pricing?
tool_flow_state: Groups references by website host. Home comes first, followed by the page type inferred from its address. Uploaded images without an address remain individual pages.
tool_compare_purpose: Compare two to four references and show what they share.
tool_compare_example: What do these three references have in common, and how do they differ?
tool_compare_state: Compares palettes, fonts, scales and page structures with their origins. Unmeasured values stay empty rather than showing zero.
tool_similar_purpose: Find the closest design neighbours of a reference.
tool_similar_example: This reference fits well. Are there more like it?
tool_similar_state: Ranks embeddings of titles, notes, tags and AI descriptions. Without EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY, only shared AI tags count.
tool_collections_purpose: List collections with descriptions, projects and counts.
tool_collections_example: Which collections belong to the hotel project?
tool_collections_state: Returns every collection. Counts include approved references only.
tool_collection_purpose: Read a collection's description and references in your chosen order.
tool_collection_example: Show all references from the Quiet hotels collection.
tool_collection_state: Returns approved references only. An empty collection is reported explicitly.
tool_components_purpose: Find individual areas such as hero, navigation or footer on real pages, including crops.
tool_components_example: Show good navigation bars from real pages.
tool_components_state: Finds areas marked in reference details, with crops and notes. If none of the requested type are marked, returns full pages whose AI tags identify that component.
tool_templates_purpose: List code templates by component type, such as hero, pricing or footer.
tool_templates_example: Is there a ready-made template for a pricing section?
tool_templates_state: No code templates are maintained. The tool tells the agent clearly and does not return the original templates.
tool_template_purpose: Read a code template's React and Tailwind code.
tool_template_example: Give me the code for this hero template.
